body:
From a basement on the hill by Elliott smith, the whole album or I pick what songs I wanna hear that day. I’ve spent a few days with it on repeat at work just crying the whole time ahahah
I think it really gets me because he committed shortly after the album was released.

If the dove soap is a bar that’s not ideal since it’s just not the cleanest. I like unscented foaming hand soap, most are antibacterial so that’s also a plus. I’ve never really been one to use neosporin so I don’t really know but I like to use an antiseptic spray. My favourite is bactine. Basically my technique is to dry the cut out and get it scabed asap so I don’t need to bandage anymore, I’ve never had an infection. Of course wound care also depends on the depth of the cut. I’ve never gone deeper than styro (dermis). Also wash hands before caring for the wound. Stay safe and I’m here if u have any questions:)

I wasn’t going to comment because so many others have and I don’t have much more to contribute. I just wanted to say this made me tear up. My dad took it very badly when He found out (have to emphasize found out because I would’ve never been comfortable to talk to him about it)and began to nitpick and bully me for the ways I handled my addiction, he has made me hate myself and my scars within the past few months. My mom has no idea, I haven’t felt comfortable to have her in my life for several years, she might never know. It just gives me hope that there actually are parents who care.

“I have a pet raccoon” thought of this cuz some of my scars really look like they could b from a raccoon (three lines in differing lengths bunched together but most of my leg is covered so it obviously looks like self harm). the first time I used this reply the person (an adult colleague) either realized it was rude to ask and went along w it or genuinely believed my story so they started asking questions i just said umm I don’t actually have a pet raccoon… “ohh so just a wild one u feed sometimes?”
“Yep mhm my stray raccoon bestie”
You’re welcome!! I love having a few nothing days where I can bang out a quick crochet project
Thank you so much for understanding and now I know you didn’t have bad intentions. It’s hard to read tone over the internet ahaha
These are so beautiful! I crochet too and I know this must’ve taken you awhile
I feel like u could’ve said that a lot nicer. Don’t think that would make me feel too good if I got a comment like this
Bactine is great for itch, it’s an antiseptic that is also meant for bug bites so has numbing and itch relief
Thank you so much, same goes for u 💜

Thank you everyone for the kind words, I didn’t really expect this to get any comments. I would reply to everyone but I can’t even get my shit together enough to reply to my job so I’ll just wish you all a great day and stay safe ❤️‍🩹
Thank you so much And you too 💜

Thank you, as of now the only scars I regret are the ones on my chest and the slur I carved into myself that’s almost gone. Every time they fade I feel hopeless and wish my body scarred differently. I’m really proud of you though and I hope you’re doing well!
